text: At the December 14 and 15, 2022 meeting of City Council, Council requested the City Manager in consultation with the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (“TRCA”) to solicit feedback from banks, insurance companies and mortgage brokers to report back on the potential of any insurance and liability issues that the City, the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority, tenants, homeowners may face from residential developments in previously Conservation Authority regulated areas that are approved by the City or the Province of Ontario. This report has been prepared in response to the request of City Council.
The Planning and Housing Committee: 1. Received the report (November 14, 2023) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer for information.
